acceptanceCriteria: The JWT rule requires base64url-JWT structure (e.g. a decodable header with alg) or an equivalent tightening, so dotted uppercase identifiers pass.
Real JWT fixtures are still detected (regression test).
The dotted adopter alias fixture seeds without SECRET_DETECTED.
body: Residual from V1-1649 (PR #1090). Expected: an obligation alias such as CHECKOUT-REGRESSION.PAYMENT-FLOW.SAVED-CARD... seeds normally. Actual: SECRET_DETECTED, because internal/secretscreen's JWT rule matches any three dot-joined runs of 10+ characters. Evidence: the first fixture alias in internal/tasks/cli/obligations_migration_test.go; recorded as a TOL failure-mode row and in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1649-obligation-migration.md. Suspected wider impact on other dotted identifiers screened by the same rule.
title: secret screen refuses dotted adopter obligation ids as JWT (SECRET_DETECTED)
